title: Linear model and gradient descent

wrong.sum_not_mean.py: gradient is not divided by N (fails the finite-difference check)
wrong.missing_transpose.py: uses X instead of X.T in the gradient (shape error)
wrong.fit_loss_after_step.py: history records the loss after the step instead of before it
wrong.fit_starts_at_ones.py: initialises w at ones instead of zeros
wrong.r2_uncentred.py: R2 denominator is not centred on mean(y)

hints: The residual r = X @ w - y appears in both the loss and the gradient. Compute it once.
Shape check: X.T is (D, N) and r is (N,), so X.T @ r is (D,). The 2/N factor comes from differentiating the mean of squares.
fit is a loop: measure the loss and gradient at the current w, record the loss, then step. r2_score is 1 - SS_res/SS_tot where SS_tot is centred on mean(y).
